legend.0: Unrelated: a different situation, component, and kind of problem; at most shared vocabulary.
legend.1: Same area only: the same codebase area or technology, but its problem, rule, or decision does not come up in this work.
legend.2: Relevant background: its problem, rule, or decision could come up in this work; worth knowing but would not on its own change what the person does.
legend.3: Directly applies: this work is in, or will meet, the situation the document records; knowing it changes what the person does or checks.
